_comment: Fixed lines the assistant speaks without the language model, from docs/call-flow.md and docs/memory.md (variant B, dial-in). Keyed by Gnani locale code; a code with no entry uses the entry with the same language prefix, then en-IN (logged). Every language in g-one.languages has an entry (FixedLinesCoverageTest). welcome is spoken only on a call that starts in a fixed language; after the English-first language question it is skipped, because the opener already introduced G-One. {name} is the name the farmer gave on an earlier call. The assistant voice is female, so Hindi lines use feminine verb forms. No digits: Timbre reads numbers better as words.
_review: The ta-IN, kn-IN, bn-IN and bn-en lines (and their welcomeBack lines) are machine-authored and have not been checked by a native speaker. They need native-speaker review before a demo. Hinglish and Benglish are written in the native script with English words, as in local-replies.json.

_welcomeBackComment: Spoken right after a returning farmer says yes to the name check, with no model (agent/brain/WelcomeBack). {name} is the remembered name. open: the newest open follow-up, read back as {item} exactly as stored (English, as the summarizer writes it); it says earlier, never last time, and never claims a deal was agreed, because memory holds no confirmed-deal record. openLong: an open item too long to read back whole (WelcomeBack.MAX_ITEM_CHARS), mentioned without its words, never cut. crop: no open item but a remembered crop ({crop}; Hindi lines use the Hindi crop word when one is known). plain: nothing to mention.
